body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Could you tell me where the post office is?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It is behind the market. Why?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Can I ask you a favour? It is quite a big one.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: My mother asked me to send a package today, but I have a meeting.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: So you want me to send it.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Yes. She told me to write the address on the back.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: No problem. Do you know how much it costs?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: I am not sure. Could you ask them if it arrives before Friday?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I will. And I will call you from there.
